dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure AcliAuthError is not swallowed by fail-open `except Exception` blocks in fetcher enrichment (fetcher.py:626/672/713) and acli.py:366 unassign — re-raise it like BackendPaginationStallError.
evidence: fetcher.py:626 `except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail-open: skip parent enrichment, write degraded snapshot` (re-raises only urllib HTTPError and BackendPaginationStallError; AcliAuthError falls into the fail-open branch)
fetcher.py:672 and fetcher.py:713 have the same fail-open shape for comment/issuelink enrichment
acli.py:366 `except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail-open: unassign non-fatal, batch continues` wraps `self.unassign_issue(jira_key)` which routes through _run_acli

The base search is outside these blocks so the reported first-call scenario works, but the docstring/commit invariant 'a rejected credential is deterministic ... fast-abort' does not hold for auth failures raised inside these enrichment/write paths
dropped.finding: AcliAuthError subclasses RuntimeError, so it is swallowed by the fetcher's fail-open `except Exception` enrichment handlers (parent/comment/issuelink) and the unassign fail-open in acli.py — a rejected credential surfacing on any of those ACLI calls degrades silently instead of fast-aborting.
scenarios: A pass whose base search succeeds with cached/valid session but where the credential is rejected mid-pass on an enrichment or unassign call — the auth failure is logged as a degraded enrichment and the pass completes with a wrong (degraded) snapshot instead of surfacing exit 2
dropped.suggested_fix: Add `except AcliAuthError: raise` (mirroring the existing `except BackendPaginationStallError: raise`) ahead of the broad `except Exception` in the enrichment blocks and the unassign fail-open, so a rejected credential propagates to the pass classifier everywhere, not only on the base search.
